up: Retrieve up to 200 metabolism records where the enzyme is CYP3A4. Join the metabolism table with compound_records on substrate_record_id to obtain the substrate name, and on drug_record_id to obtain the parent compound name. Also join with compound_structures to retrieve the substrate's canonical SMILES as the substrate structure. Return the following columns: substrate_structure (canonical SMILES), substrate_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, and organism. Limit the results to 200 rows.
sql: SELECT cs.canonical_smiles AS substrate_structure, cr_sub.compound_name AS substrate_name, cr_par.compound_name AS parent_compound_name, m.met_conversion AS metabolic_conversion, m.pathway_key AS pathway, m.organism AS organism FROM metabolism m JOIN compound_records cr_sub ON m.substrate_record_id = cr_sub.record_id JOIN compound_records cr_par ON m.drug_record_id = cr_par.record_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr_sub.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE m.enzyme_name = 'CYP3A4' LIMIT 200
